articles.title: JWST Reveals a Planet Where Rock Clouds Form and Vanish Daily
articles.summary: On the exoplanet WASP-94A b, clouds of magnesium silicate appear every morning and disappear by evening. The James Webb Space Telescope captured this cycle, solving a mystery about the planet's atmosphere and revealing it's more like Jupiter than previously thought.

articles.title: DNA Analysis Reveals Seychelles' Lost Crocodiles Were Saltwater Giants
articles.summary: A genetic study of museum specimens has solved a 250-year-old mystery: the crocodiles that once inhabited the Seychelles were saltwater crocodiles, not a unique species. They likely drifted over 3,000 km across the Indian Ocean to colonize the remote islands.

articles.title: New Superconductor Breaks 30-Year Record at Ambient Pressure
articles.summary: University of Houston researchers achieved superconductivity at 151 Kelvin (-122°C) under normal pressure, surpassing a record held since 1993. The breakthrough uses pressure quenching to stabilize a high-temperature phase, potentially revolutionizing energy transmission and medical imaging.
